## 5666b68dd4b9

**A5666-1 — Suspected shortcut with a reproduced separating input.** A solver can ignore the top-left colour selector and choose the largest body component whose tight crop is asymmetric under a 180-degree turn. This rival matches **32/32 unique generated inputs and 4/4 canonical pairs** against fresh public Racket execution. The generator always supplies a symmetric eight-cell ring as its large distractor, plus symmetric domino/singleton distractors; this leaves the selected asymmetric motif identifiable without its selector. This is a distribution blind spot. No Racket-label or mirror mismatch was found in the 37 inputs checked.

The audit target was unchanged: generator version `2.0.0`, SHA-256 `a894ec3d03b38e2d7a91b9269cced43654b6e73d8c811c2309cf22fd4f5e485a`. The canonical program SHA-256 is `5a2705a2ea24651cae2cfe9485b1bfb2a459da06b88235338483bc87e62a27f1`, whose short rule hash is `5a2705a2ea24`. The public application receipt additionally binds the executed rule text to SHA-256 `dac1ed9bd052cbca4631ea4580d97ec13bb2f6891355f0380fb663199ed31f38`.

**Concrete witness.** Generate `seed=0`, `sample_index=1`, `difficulty="hard"`, with no overrides; then change zero-based cell `(7,1)` from `9` to `0`, removing one corner of the large wrong-colour ring. This creates a seven-cell asymmetric colour-9 distractor while preserving the selected six-cell colour-6 source. Both `self_check` and `strict_canonical_like` return `[]`. The input satisfies the declared structural invariants and canonical dimension/source envelope. It is **not emitted by the current implementation**, which always paints the intact ring. The Racket authority selects colour 6 and rotates it 180 degrees; the selector-blind rival chooses colour 9. Their outputs differ at nine cells. The full input, actual output, rival output, mutation, acceptance results, hashes, and command are retained in [counterexample.json](checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/counterexample.json); it is application result index `36` in [racket.json](checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/racket.json).

**Measured scope.** The generated census was seeds `0..7` × sample indices `0..3`, hard difficulty, no overrides: 32 unique inputs containing four of the six source templates. Four exact canonical pairs and the single mutation brought the public Racket batch to 37. All 37 passed both validators, produced valid Racket outputs, and matched the existing Python mirror. The four canonical Racket results also matched their recorded labels. The eight nonoverlapping four-demonstration blocks each refuted all six actual `LESSON_COMPETITORS` declarations, while this new rival survived all four demonstrations in every block. The actual `CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS` declaration was separately checked and matched all four canonical pairs. Counts and refuting indices are in [summary.json](checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/summary.json). Earlier review receipts were read as background, not counted as new verification.

The supported authority command ran from the packet root and exited `0`:

```bash
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 5666b68dd4b9 --input ../checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/input.json --out ../checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/racket.json
```

The wrapper's effective working directory was `repo`. The independent rival and deterministic preparation are in [probe.py](checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/probe.py); saved evidence validation and declared-rival scoring are in [verify.py](checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/verify.py). Exact commands, working directories, outputs, and all three successful exit codes are in [command_receipts.json](checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/command_receipts.json). The exact canonical record is retained in [canonical_record.json](checks/audit/5666b68dd4b9/canonical_record.json).

**Follow-up and limits.** A future target-local repair should emit larger asymmetric wrong-colour distractors and retain this canonical-fitting rival with a selector-dependent witness. This audit did not modify the target or its rule. Other difficulty bands, exhaustive joint overrides, query rotations, and all stream starts were not tested; the eight blocks are demonstration sets, not a full production-lesson census. The result establishes a useful missing distinction, not universal failure or exhaustive shortcut coverage.
